# PowerX Electrical Ltd

> Licensed, insured 24/7 emergency electrician serving Surrey and the entire Lower Mainland & Fraser Valley, British Columbia, Canada. Phone: 778-823-1575. Based at 12491 68 Avenue, Surrey, BC V3W 2C9. Rated 4.9/5 from 80+ Google reviews.

PowerX Electrical Ltd is a local electrical contractor offering transparent flat-rate pricing, 30–60 minute emergency response, and code-compliant work to the BC Electrical Code. Services cover residential, commercial, industrial and strata electrical.

## Services
- [24/7 Emergency Electrician](https://powerxelectrical.ca/services/emergency-electrician.html): When the power goes out or something smells like it is burning, you need a real licensed electrician now — not an answering service.
- [Electrical Panel Upgrades](https://powerxelectrical.ca/services/electrical-panel-upgrades.html): Older 60A and 100A panels can't keep up with heat pumps, EV chargers, AC and modern appliances.
- [200A Service Upgrades](https://powerxelectrical.ca/services/electrical-service-upgrades.html): Adding a suite, heat pump, EV charger or workshop? A full service upgrade increases the power coming into your home, not just the panel — done to code with permits and BC Hydro coordination.
- [EV Charger Installation](https://powerxelectrical.ca/services/ev-charger-installation.html): Charge at home overnight.
- [Home Wiring & Rewiring](https://powerxelectrical.ca/services/home-rewiring.html): From a single circuit to a complete rewire, we wire homes safely and cleanly — renovations, additions, new construction, and replacement of dangerous knob-and-tube or aluminum wiring.
- [Aluminum Wiring Replacement](https://powerxelectrical.ca/services/aluminum-wiring-replacement.html): Homes wired in the 1960s–70s often have aluminum branch wiring, a known fire risk at connections.
- [Lighting & Pot Lights](https://powerxelectrical.ca/services/lighting-installation.html): Recessed pot lights, under-cabinet LEDs, landscape lighting, dimmers and smart switches — installed cleanly and wired to last.
- [Generators & Backup Power](https://powerxelectrical.ca/services/generator-installation.html): Windstorms knock out Lower Mainland power every year.
- [Hot Tub & Pool Wiring](https://powerxelectrical.ca/services/hot-tub-pool-wiring.html): Hot tubs and pools mix water and 240V power, so they demand proper GFCI protection, bonding and a dedicated circuit.
- [Commercial & Industrial](https://powerxelectrical.ca/services/commercial-electrical.html): Retail, office, warehouse and light industrial — we deliver code-compliant commercial electrical work that respects your deadlines, your budget and your need to stay open.
- [Tenant Improvements & Fit-Outs](https://powerxelectrical.ca/services/tenant-improvements.html): Opening or renovating a commercial space? We deliver the electrical scope of your tenant improvement on time — power, lighting, data and devices, coordinated with every other trade.
- [Strata & Multi-Unit](https://powerxelectrical.ca/services/strata-electrical.html): Property managers and strata councils trust PowerX for common-area lighting, parkade EV charging, suite repairs, panel upgrades and reliable emergency response across the Lower Mainland.
- [Commercial LED Retrofits](https://powerxelectrical.ca/services/led-lighting-retrofits.html): LED retrofits cut lighting energy use dramatically and pay for themselves.
- [Fire Alarm & Life Safety](https://powerxelectrical.ca/services/fire-alarm-systems.html): Fire alarm and emergency lighting systems protect lives and keep you compliant.
